run_nest_game: run an EGG game on SLURM using nest with --game egg.zoo.mnist_autoenc.train
run_nest_sweep: run a parameter sweep on SLURM using nest with --sweep file.json to launch jobs
run_nest_py_sweep: run a Python-based grid sweep on SLURM using nest with --py_sweep module.grid
run_nest_preview: preview all job combinations without launching using nest with --preview or --dry_run
run_nest_array: run EGG jobs as a SLURM array using nest with --array and --array_parallelism
